canonical_kb.basis: Exact byte-for-byte copy of the richer model-facing knowledge_base.json after source reconciliation.

sources.note: Receipts identified this as the same Git blob as model-facing-v0/execution_knowledge_base.json; it is provenance-only and is not duplicated in the canonical KB.

reconciliation.identity_rule: Canonical record ID governs duplicate identity when IDs match.
reconciliation.field_rule: For duplicate IDs, retain the richest canonical record; do not duplicate compact projections that omit fields already present in the richer record.
reconciliation.semantic_duplicate_rule: Records with the same canonical ID and same semantic responsibility are one canonical entry even when a source projection is shorter.
reconciliation.top_level_metadata_rule: Source schema, version, purpose, path, and blob identity are preserved in this manifest rather than duplicated into KB records.
reconciliation.context_result: Every entry in model_facing_context_kb.json is represented by the corresponding richer context.* record in knowledge_base.json.
reconciliation.execution_result: The execution KB is a compact projection of records represented in the richer model-facing KB; the richer records preserve additional requirements, required_output_schema, example procedures, and other fields where present.
reconciliation.duplication_policy: No duplicate canonical records are intentionally emitted.
